# Data Source: tfe_current_user

Get the current user associated with the API token. When authenticated with a team or organization token, HCP Terraform returns a synthetic service user rather than a real user account, so attributes like `Email` and `Username` will not reflect a real person.

## Example Usage

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/dataTfeCurrentUser"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent :=
	dataTfeCurrentUser.NewDataTfeCurrentUser(this, jsii.String("current"), &DataTfeCurrentUserConfig{
	})
	cdktf.NewTerraformOutput(this, jsii.String("email"), &TerraformOutputConfig{
		Value: dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent.email,
	})
	return this
}
```

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/dataTfeCurrentUser"
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/organizationMembership"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent :=
	dataTfeCurrentUser.NewDataTfeCurrentUser(this, jsii.String("current"), &DataTfeCurrentUserConfig{
	})
	organizationMembership.NewOrganizationMembership(this, jsii.String("owner"), &OrganizationMembershipConfig{
		email: cdktf.Token_AsString(dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent.email),
		organization: jsii.String("my-org"),
	})
	return this
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `Email` (String) The email address of the current user.
- `Id` (String) The ID for the user.
- `IsServiceAccount` (Boolean) Whether the current user is a service account.
- `Username` (String) The username of the current user.
